scenarios.name: Companion startup
scenarios.expected: Companion binds exclusively to 127.0.0.1:7000 and /companion/health returns 200 OK

scenarios.name: Manifest access
scenarios.expected: Valid JSON manifest with id com.subtitleme.addon and version 1.0.0-rc.1

scenarios.name: Install addon in Stremio Desktop
scenarios.preconditions: Stremio Desktop open on same computer
scenarios.procedure: Copy configured manifest URL from /configure and paste in Stremio Addons -> + Add Addon
scenarios.expected: SubtitleMe appears installed in Stremio Addons list

scenarios.name: Bilingual track discovery
scenarios.preconditions: Primary and secondary subtitles uploaded for test contentId (e.g. tt1254207)
scenarios.procedure: Start playback of matching title in Stremio Desktop and open subtitle picker

scenarios.name: Simultaneous dual-language rendering
scenarios.expected: Both languages render simultaneously and legibly without CSS dependency

scenarios.name: Stacking order (primary-top vs secondary-top)
scenarios.preconditions: Reconfigure order in /configure and reinstall configured manifest URL
scenarios.procedure: Compare vertical order of primary and secondary lines

scenarios.name: Independent timing offsets
scenarios.procedure: Observe cue entry/exit timing for each language independently
scenarios.expected: Each language shifts according to its own offset

scenarios.name: Simultaneous cues
scenarios.preconditions: Both tracks share identical start/end timestamps
scenarios.expected: Single combined cue with clean line break and zero duplicate text

scenarios.name: Partially overlapping cues
scenarios.procedure: Inspect transition into and out of overlap
scenarios.expected: Smooth transitions without flicker or dropped lines

scenarios.name: Multiline cues
scenarios.preconditions: Primary or secondary cue contains multiple lines
scenarios.expected: All lines remain readable without clipping

scenarios.name: Portuguese accents and special characters
scenarios.expected: All UTF-8 characters render cleanly without mojibake

scenarios.name: Content switching
scenarios.preconditions: Two distinct contentIds uploaded in Companion
scenarios.procedure: Switch playback from video A to video B
scenarios.expected: Each video displays only its explicitly associated subtitle pair

scenarios.name: Missing one track
scenarios.preconditions: Only primary subtitle uploaded for a contentId
scenarios.procedure: Play that contentId in Stremio Desktop
scenarios.expected: Addon returns empty list cleanly without mislabeling single-language track

scenarios.name: Track deletion and cache invalidation
scenarios.preconditions: Active generated VTT URL from scenario 5
scenarios.procedure: Remove one track in /configure and re-request the previous VTT URL
scenarios.expected: Previous VTT URL immediately returns 404 Not Found; reloading subtitles reflects update
